title: LLMs Should Express Uncertainty Explicitly
authors: Junyu Guo; Shangding Gu; Ming Jin; Costas Spanos; Javad Lavaei
why_relevant: Trains LLMs to explicitly express uncertainty (verbalized confidence or <uncertain> marker) that can trigger adaptive retrieval and abstention, directly relevant to calibration/control for when to retrieve.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on uncertainty expression broadly; RAG triggering is one application, not the central study.
suggested_section: Calibration and Control (when to retrieve / abstain)
